_comment: Clarity in the Quran (@ClarityInTheQuran, UC0eBu0ZXcF20pTAG3lUnPXA) channel layout, 2026-08-22. The channel has no Home tab: tabs are [Videos, Shorts, Playlists, Posts] where the reference channel @deepmadesimple has [Home, Videos, Playlists, Posts]. A missing Home tab means no layout is configured, so every visitor lands on a flat reverse-chronological grid whose top item is currently the newest upload rather than the one that actually converts.
_expect_channel_id: Enforced before any write, exactly as in clarity_packaging.py: the script resolves the authenticated channel with mine=true and aborts unless it is this id. The branding write is a fetch-then-mutate, so pointed at the wrong channel it would overwrite THAT channel's keywords and country in one silent call.

unsubscribed_trailer._title: What the Quran Actually Says About Anger | Clarity In The Quran
unsubscribed_trailer._why: 849 views — a third of the channel's lifetime audience — and the highest of any upload. It is 6:17, a complete standalone explainer rather than a fragment, and it already leads the largest playlist. A purpose-made trailer would be better and does not exist; featuring the proven performer is the standard fallback. This is a reversible one-field write: change video_id here and re-run to move it.
unsubscribed_trailer._caveat: This sets the trailer shown to UNSUBSCRIBED viewers only. The separate 'featured video for returning subscribers' has no field in the Data API and stays a Studio task.

sections.playlist_title: What the Quran Says About Your Emotions
sections._why: First because it is the largest list (5), holds the 849-view leader, and its subject is the universal-problem entry point that brought this channel every result it has.

sections.playlist_title: Stories of the Prophets in the Quran
sections._why: Second: 3 videos including two ~190-view performers, and the route that gives the newest upload access to viewers arriving on them.
Third: 5 videos, but its strongest is 64 views and it now carries the 31:29 upload, so it earns a row without leading.

sections.playlist_title: Money and Provision in the Quran
sections._why: Fourth: only 2 videos, led by 226 views. A real shelf but the thinnest one.

_sections: Playlists are addressed by TITLE and resolved to ids live, the same way clarity_playlists.py and clarity_crosslinks.py do it. Hard-coding the PL ids here would rot the moment a list is rebuilt, and a section pointing at a dead id renders as an empty row.
_section_order: Order in this array is the order of the rows under the trailer. Position is assigned from the index, after any sections that already exist.
